facts.fact: INE Angola says it adopted the industry ministry's administrative data from July 2025 as the source for the manufacturing section of its Industrial Production Index, which it published, before dropping them in the August 2026 publication.
facts.system: Portal da Indústria (MINDCOM) data feeding the Índice de Produção Industrial

facts.fact: INE Angola's manufacturing production index drew from July 2025 on the Ministry of Industry and Commerce's administrative data via its Portal da Indústria, until INE reverted to a direct survey of 183 industrial units.
facts.system: Portal da Indústria (MINDCOM) data feeding the Índice de Produção Industrial

facts.fact: The Índice de Produção Industrial manufacturing series was compiled from industry-ministry administrative data from July 2025, then returned to a 183-unit direct sample per INE's technical note in the August 2026 release.
